note: After the revision by Constantino (1995); the original is in English. Alates, soldiers and large workers are described. Alate measurements: 2 individuals from 2 colonies, head length 2.15—2.25 mm, head width without the eyes 2.55—2.60 mm, fontanelle length 0.25—0.29 mm, pronotum length 1.60—1.75 mm, width 2.75—3.05 mm, hind tibia length 4.85—5.10 mm, maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.55—0.59 mm, ocellus length 0.29 mm, forewing length 20.00—21.50 mm; large-worker measurements are listed separately in the original (5 individuals from 5 colonies). OCR word breaks ('2.1;V2.25', '2.611') have been corrected from the context.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The diagnostic characters are given in the comparison under S. longiceps: the alate shares with S. longiceps the combination of small size, acutely pointed anterior corners of the pronotum, small compound eyes, 2 short setae on the postclypeus and dark wings.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Compound eyes small, less than 1/4 of the head width; ocelli large; fontanelle small and round. Antennae 19-segmented. Anterior corners of the pronotum angular with an acute projection; lateral margins straight and nearly parallel on the anterior half. Wings short, apex of the mediana and cubitus distinct. sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule elongate with parallel sides; posterior margin of the head round. Frontal tube prominent, the pore not visible in dorsal view. Labrum short, length and width subequal; lateral angles about equal to or slightly greater than a right angle; midlobe relatively large. Antennae 19-segmented. Postmentum not constricted, the sides of the posterior part nearly parallel. Mandibles elongate and straight, only slightly hooked at the apex; first marginal tooth of the left mandible near the base and small, barely projecting beyond the apical cutting edge; first marginal tooth of the right mandible very small and close to the base; apical cutting edge of the left mandible evenly curved, with a notch only before M1; apical cutting edge of the right mandible straight, curved only at the apex. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head capsule with a few scattered setae; postclypeus with 4 setae; fontanelle round and small. Antennae 19-segmented. Spines of the thoracic nota weak. Mandibles similar to S. longiceps, the molar plate narrow; hind gut also similar to S. longiceps, but the material is poorly preserved.
